analysis.summary: Krishana Phoschem Limited reported its Q1 FY27 earnings, noting a challenging operating environment due to global supply-side disruptions, elevated raw material costs, and geopolitical uncertainties. Despite these headwinds, the company achieved a 35% year-on-year growth in quarterly revenue from operations at Rs. 532 crore and a 36% year-on-year increase in EBITDA to Rs. 89 crore. Management highlighted a strong monsoon revival, improved capacity utilization, and the introduction of new complex fertilizer variants as drivers of resilient performance and future growth.

guidance.claim: Management expects to achieve an additional 30% to 35% turnover over last year.
guidance.quote: We hope that we will be able to achieve our target for this year, which comes to around 25% of last year's revenue. So, your figure of 30%–35%, we can say that we will be able to achieve it.

guidance.claim: The company expects to achieve a quarterly turnover of more than Rs. 500 crore over the remaining three quarters of FY27.
guidance.quote: We expect to achieve a quarterly turnover of more than ₹500 crore over the remaining three quarters of FY27, supported by improved capacity utilization and production.

guidance.claim: The company expects to deliver over 40% growth across key parameters during the current financial year.
guidance.quote: Accordingly, we expect to deliver growth of over 40% across key parameters during the current year.

guidance.claim: Management expects a top-line increase of Rs. 500 crore from the newly expanded capacity.
guidance.quote: We are expecting a top-line increase of Rs.500 crore.

guidance.claim: The company targets overall revenue growth in the range of 35% to 40% in FY27.
guidance.quote: So overall, we hope 35%-40% revenue growth in FY27.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that fertilizer sales remained strong despite lower industry production levels.
demand_outlook.quote: Despite lower production levels, sales remained strong, with NPK sales increasing by 33% year- on-year and SSP sales growing by 28% year-on-year during the same period.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that improved monsoon conditions and higher MSP are expected to support fertilizer demand during the remainder of FY27.
demand_outlook.quote: Improving in monsoon conditions, higher MSP and continued government support through the Nutrient Based Subsidy (NBS) framework are expected to support the fertilizer demand during the remainder of FY27.

demand_outlook.claim: Management expects the Kharif season demand environment to be constructive due to comfortable domestic stock levels and favorable monsoon forecasts.
demand_outlook.quote: With comfortable domestic stock levels & a favourable monsoon forecast, the Kharif season demand environment appears constructive for the industry.

demand_outlook.claim: The government's fertilizer subsidy outlay exceeding ₹2.4 lakh crore for FY27 is expected to support farmer affordability and sector stability.
demand_outlook.quote: The Cabinet's approval of NBS rates for Kharif 2026, alongside a fertilizer subsidy outlay exceeding ₹2.4 lakh crore for FY27, underscores the government's commitment to farmer affordability & sector stability.

demand_outlook.claim: The quarter ended March 2026 experienced stable demand dynamics during the Rabi season.
demand_outlook.quote: On the Rabi season, the quarter ended March ‘26, witnessed stable demand dynamics during the Rabi season.

demand_outlook.claim: Domestic fertilizer manufacturers are unlikely to face demand pressure as food demand is non-negotiable.
demand_outlook.quote: From our perspective, domestic manufacturers are unlikely to face demand pressure.

demand_outlook.claim: A stable agricultural environment and favorable monsoon outlook support a constructive demand outlook for fertilizers.
demand_outlook.quote: On one hand, a stable agricultural environment supported by a favorable monsoon outlook provides a constructive demand outlook.

capex_expansion.claim: Management stated that the company is currently evaluating certain capacity expansion opportunities.
capex_expansion.quote: We are currently evaluating certain capacity expansion opportunities.

capex_expansion.claim: The company has expanded its Meghnagar facility with NPK/DAP capacity at 165,000 MTPA and Sulphuric Acid at 99,000 MTPA.
capex_expansion.quote: Our expanded capacities at Meghnagar — NPK/DAP at 165,000 MTPA and Sulphuric Acid at 99,000 MTPA — are now contributing progressively to our performance.

capex_expansion.claim: Krishana Phoschem enhanced its NPK/DAP capacity by 50% to 495,000 MTPA, bringing total phosphatic fertilizer capacity to 615,000 MTPA.
capex_expansion.quote: NPK/DAP capacity enhanced by 50% to 495,000 MTPA and existing SSP capacity at 120,000 MTPA, taking total phosphatic fertilizer capacity to 615,000 MTPA

capex_expansion.claim: Backward integration was strengthened with a sulphuric acid capacity of 99,000 MTPA.
capex_expansion.quote: Backward integration strengthened with sulphuric acid capacity of 99,000 MTPA

capex_expansion.claim: The company entered into a 10-year Green Ammonia Sale Agreement for 70,000 MTPA under India's National Green Hydrogen Mission.
capex_expansion.quote: As part of our long-term sustainability strategy, Krishana Phoschem has entered into a 10-year Green Ammonia Sale Agreement (GASA) under India’s National Green Hydrogen Mission for 70,000 MTPA.

margins_costs.claim: Management stated that overall, the company has been able to pass on approximately 25% to 30% of the increase in input costs.
margins_costs.quote: Overall, we have been able to pass on ~ 25%–30% of the increase in input costs.

margins_costs.claim: Management stated that EBITDA margins are approximately 7% to 8% for trading and around 16% for manufacturing.
margins_costs.quote: The EBITDA margin is approximately 7%–8% for trading and around 16% for manufacturing.

margins_costs.claim: Global input prices firmed up from mid-February onwards due to supply constraints, freight costs, and gas tightness.
margins_costs.quote: However, from mid-February onwards, global market witnessed firming trends driven by supply-side constraints, tightness in gas-linked production, higher logistic and freight costs.

margins_costs.claim: Company profitability is expected to decrease slightly in FY27 due to cost absorption.
margins_costs.quote: Yes, of course, we will absorb to some extent and as a result, our profitability is expected to come down slightly during the current year FY27.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA per ton on manufactured products was around Rs. 5,500 per ton in FY26.
margins_costs.quote: It was in the range of Rs.5,500 per ton.

margins_costs.claim: Current raw material prices for sulfur are fluctuating in the range of Rs. 55,000 to Rs. 70,000 per ton.
margins_costs.quote: The prices are changing and prices are in the range of around Rs.55,000 to Rs.70,000 per ton, depending on the supplier and what time we are buying and what are the payment terms.

orders_capacity.claim: Management stated that the company achieved 43% capacity utilization of the NPK-DAP unit and 121% capacity utilization of the SSP unit during the quarter.
orders_capacity.quote: 43% capacity utilization of NPK-DAP unit and 121% capacity utilization of SSP unit, which was beyond the core.

orders_capacity.claim: Management stated that the total NPK-DAP capacity is 495,000 metric tonnes.
orders_capacity.quote: Our existing NPK-DAP capacity is 330,000 MT, and we have added another 165,000 MT, taking the total capacity to 495,000 MT.

orders_capacity.claim: The company has an installed capacity of 6.15 Lakh MTPA.
Total production for FY26 reached 397,263 MT supported by strong market demand.
orders_capacity.quote: Achieved total production of 397,263 MT, supported by High demand across markets

orders_capacity.claim: Fertilizer production reached 94,103 MT in Q4 FY26.
orders_capacity.quote: Achieved fertilizer production of 94,103 MT, driven by peak Rabi season demand and improved operational throughput

orders_capacity.claim: NPK/DAP and SSP plants operated above rated capacity during FY26.
orders_capacity.quote: Record high utilization levels in NPK/DAP and SSP plants operating above rated capacity, highlighting strong market acceptance and efficient asset utilization

orders_capacity.claim: Rock phosphate beneficiation capacity stands at 200,000 tons with utilization currently between 50% and 75%.
orders_capacity.quote: The beneficiation capacity is around 200,000 tons, and current utilization is in the range of 50% to 75%.

capital_allocation.claim: Management stated that the company successfully executed a 5-for-1 stock split to enhance market liquidity and improve affordability.
capital_allocation.quote: Recently, the company successfully executed a 5-for-1 stock split, subdividing the face value of our equity shares from ₹ 10 per share to ₹ 2 per share. This corporate action was strategically undertaken to enhance market liquidity, improve affordability for retail investors and broaden our long-term shareholder base.

capital_allocation.claim: Capacity expansion was funded using a combination of internal accruals and term loans.
capital_allocation.quote: This expansion has been funded through a prudent mix of internal accruals and term loans, reflecting disciplined capital allocation.

capital_allocation.claim: The company's effective interest cost across borrowings ranges between 6% and 7.5%.
capital_allocation.quote: Overall, the effective interest cost is in the range of 6% to 7.5%.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management cited global supply-side disruptions, elevated raw material prices, and geopolitical uncertainties as challenges for the phosphatic supplier industry.
risks_headwinds.quote: The 1st Quarter witnessed a challenging operating environment for the phosphatic supplier industry, primarily driven by global supply-side disruptions, elevated raw material prices, and geopolitical uncertainties.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that geopolitical tensions in West Asia and shipping route uncertainties resulted in higher freight costs and delayed vessel movements.
risks_headwinds.quote: Geopolitical tensions in West Asia, particularly surrounding critical shipping lanes through the Strait of Hormuz, introduced considerable uncertainty across global industry, global fertilizer supply chains during the quarter. Given India's dependence on imported rock phosphate, phosphatic acid, sulfur, and ammonia, the broader phosphatic industry remained vulnerable to these disruptions. The uncertainty surrounding shipping routes resulted in higher freight costs, delay in vessel movement, and increased procurement costs.

risks_headwinds.claim: Input cost volatility and global supply uncertainties remain key monitorable factors for the company.
risks_headwinds.quote: On the other hand, input cost volatility and global supply uncertainties remain key monitorable.

risks_headwinds.claim: A timing mismatch occurred in March as domestic demand slowed while global input costs increased.
risks_headwinds.quote: This created a timing mismatch where domestic demand was slowed down in March while input costs were increasing, leading to higher cost pressure in the closing quarter.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated that the green ammonia capacity will start in FY29 after 2 years.
management_commitments.quote: And this capacity will start in FY29 after 2 years.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects to deliver over 40% growth across key operational metrics during FY27.
management_commitments.quote: Accordingly, we expect to deliver growth of over 40% across key parameters during the current year.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects overall revenue growth between 35% and 40% in FY27.
management_commitments.quote: So overall, we hope 35%-40% revenue growth in FY27.

management_commitments.claim: Benefits of recent capacity expansions are expected to meaningfully reflect in financial performance from FY27 onwards.
management_commitments.quote: With enhanced capacities now operational, we expect the benefits of this expansion to meaningfully reflect in our performance from FY27 onwards, supported by improved scale, operating leverage, and better efficiency levels.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
